periods.summary: Students and teachers hold a small party to welcome Lux into the academy after his first difficult day of classes and chores.
periods.cause: Lisha and the academy girls want to thank and welcome Lux after the Gargoyle incident and his trial enrollment.
periods.process: Lisha, Philuffy, Krulcifer, the Triad, Airi, classmates, and Regrie gather with homemade food and drinks in the dormitory dining hall.
periods.outcome: Lux feels accepted by the academy community for the first time.
periods.aftermath: He later realizes he has no sleeping room and is carried into Philuffy's room after falling asleep in the hallway.
periods.significance: Marks Lux's first emotional place of belonging in the New Kingdom academy.
